# Pinned public-book editions

These are the exact EPUBs used to verify MicroBook 2.0. Their SHA-256 hashes,
source links, and licensing information are recorded in
[public-books.json](../../public-books.json). Each EPUB retains its Project
Gutenberg license.

Gutenberg periodically regenerates its downloads, so a live download can change
without a change to our tests. Keep these editions unchanged; review a new
edition and update its hash deliberately when changing the corpus.

The verification tool uses these files when its local cache is empty. The
“Cache pinned public books” workflow also makes them available to release tags
that predate the archived fixtures, without changing those tags or accepting
different source bytes.
